body_md:
## Fresh developments (last 24–72h)

**Memory/DRAM (Signals 1 & 2)**
TrendForce Sept 30 note confirms Q4 2026 conventional DRAM prices expected +10–15% QoQ — decelerating from Q1's ~+93% and Q2's ~+58%, but still positive. Consumer-side pressure persists; AI server demand sustains contract floors. HBM4 final paid samples now flowing from both Samsung and SK Hynix to NVIDIA. Micron ramping HBM to ~100K wafers/month by year-end (vs. Samsung/SK Hynix ~150K–200K each). Capacity expansion is tracking the baseline correction-risk timeline for late-2026/early-2027.

**Hyperscaler capex (Signal 3)**
No guide-downs. Meta raised 2026 capex to $125B–145B; Amazon ~$220B; Google ~$195–205B; Microsoft ~$175B. Combined tracking ~$720–745B — above the $600–700B baseline. SpaceX reportedly in talks to borrow $40B to buy NVIDIA chips — significant single-customer demand signal for NVDA.

**Custom ASIC / AMD (Signal 4)**
AMD MI400/Helios (72× MI455X, 31 TB aggregate HBM4, 1.7 PB/s bandwidth) confirmed in production. Google TPU v7 Ironwood at 2M+ chips in production; AWS Trainium 3 ramping at 1M+. Custom ASIC share-shift accelerating; structural bear for NVDA GPU share long-term, bull for AVGO/MRVL.

**Optical (Signal 5)**
Coherent showcased at ECOC 2026; FY2026 full-year revenue $7.1B, +34% YoY. InP capacity on track to double by end-2026 per NVIDIA $4B commitment. CPO entering inaugural volume deployment year (2026 per EDN). No fresh lead-time change this week.

**Solar (Signal 6)**
Section 232 tariffs signed Aug 7, effective Dec 4, 2026: 15% on polysilicon + price floors (cells $0.22/W, modules $0.38/W). FSLR faces inventory glut + indirect cost pressure from polysilicon derivatives. Imported module cost floor post-tariff ~$0.38–0.40/W. No fresh ENPH/NXT/ARRY catalysts in last 24h.

## Watchlist movers

| Name | Move | Catalyst |

| ALAB | +7.58% (Oct 6) | Scorpio X AI fabric switches entered volume production *ahead of schedule*; Q3 guide $540–560M; +118% YTD |
| MRVL | Significant | Investor Day Oct 6: FY28 revenue raised to ~$18B; AI TAM expansion; $70–$90B FY2031 range outlined |
| CRDO | +3.93% (Oct 6) | ZeroFlap Optics + optical DSPs each >$100M FY2027; ranked #1 AI networking stock (WarrenAI) |
| AMD | +3.60% | MI400/Helios production ramp momentum |
| MU | −1.73% | No specific catalyst; HBM4 annual pricing negotiation season beginning |
| NVDA | Stable/positive | SpaceX $40B chip financing discussion; Lambda $4B pre-IPO round |

*No notable COHR/LITE/CIEN/FSLR/ENPH/HIVE catalysts in last 24h.*

---

## Context (vs baseline)

- Memory pricing decelerating as expected but not yet in correction — baseline correction risk remains a 2027 event.
- HBM4 sample delivery on-track; late-2026 correction risk live as all three suppliers expand.
- Hyperscaler capex above baseline; zero guide-down signals.
- MRVL's ~$18B FY2028 target and ALAB's ahead-of-schedule volume confirm AI custom-silicon/networking is maturing into revenue, not just design wins.

---

| HBM4 capacity | On-track; samples to NVIDIA | Neutral-to-bear (correction risk builds late-2026) |
| Hyperscaler capex | Above baseline; no guide-down | Bull |
| Custom ASIC share-shift | Accelerating (TPU, Trainium, MRVL) | Bear NVDA share long-term; bull AVGO/MRVL |
| Optical/CPO | CPO volume deployment 2026 confirmed | Bull COHR/LITE |
| Solar tariffs | Section 232 effective Dec 4 | Mixed: bull domestic, bear importers |
| AI networking (ALAB/CRDO/MRVL) | Strong moves; production beats | Bull |

---

## Most important development

**Marvell Investor Day + ALAB Scorpio X production beat** — MRVL raised FY2028 total revenue target to ~$18B (FY2031 range $70–$90B) driven by AI custom silicon; ALAB's Scorpio X AI fabric switches entered volume production *ahead of schedule* (+7.58%, +118% YTD). Together these confirm the AI networking/custom-silicon layer is maturing from design wins into revenue events. Pair with SpaceX's reported $40B NVIDIA chip borrowing as evidence hyperscaler-adjacent AI compute demand remains unabated heading into Q4-2026.
